Supermicro H12SSL-i Motherboard + AMD EPYC 7452 32-Core CPU + Cooler Combo

Up for sale is a tested, working server/workstation combo built around the Supermicro H12SSL-i and AMD's 32-core EPYC 7452. This hardware was pulled from a professional enterprise server environment, so it has been run in a climate-controlled data center setting rather than a home or hobby build. It's a great foundation for a homelab, virtualization host, multi-GPU compute rig, or AI/rendering workstation.

What's included:

  • Supermicro H12SSL-i motherboard
  • AMD EPYC 7452 CPU + Cooler Combo
  • I/O Shield NOT Included
  • RAM, Case, and Power Supply are NOT included

AMD EPYC 7452 specs:

  • 32 cores / 64 threads, Zen 2 (Rome)
  • 2.35 GHz base, up to 3.35 GHz boost
  • 128 MB L3 cache, 155 W TDP

Supermicro H12SSL-i specs:

  • Socket SP3, supports EPYC 7002 and 7003 series
  • Version 1.02
  • ATX form factor (12" x 10")
  • 8 DIMM slots, DDR4-3200 ECC RDIMM/LRDIMM, up to 2 TB
  • 5x PCIe 4.0 x16 and 2x PCIe 4.0 x8 slots
  • 2x M.2 NVMe slots
  • Dual 1GbE LAN plus dedicated IPMI port for remote management

Shipping:
Each component will be carefully disassembled, cleaned, and individually wrapped in bubble wrap. The motherboard, CPU, and cooler ship separately protected within the same box and plenty of padding to prevent movement in transit.
